messages:
maria: Heads-up 1: CloudWave updated their APAC marketplace manifest; several POs shifted and one PO was split across two delivery windows. This impacts our Dedicated onboarding.
leo: which POs? paste the snippet if you can.
maria: carrier notes attached. PO IDs: CW-PO-4471, CW-PO-4472, CW-PO-4473. CW-PO-4472 split: 40% ETA 2026-09-15, 60% ETA 2026-09-29.
oliver: that gap breaks our EU ramp if we can't backfill the week of 9/22. Do we have spare staging inventory?
sophia: two enterprise trials expect Dedicated week of 9/20. Sales will escalate if we miss. Need a contingency.
maria: CloudWave offered an early partial pickup from a local fulfillment center (not guaranteed) or to reprioritize CW-PO-4473 earlier for a fee1. That would delay another customer.
leo: owner for customer comms? we need 48h notice if we change windows.
rahul: i'll own comms if we decide today. need ops confirmation on US staging pool.
oliver: quick check: US staging ~12 racks free, kitting/firmware backlog ~5 days. If we expedite ops we can free ~6 racks sooner but it costs.
sophia: propose: accept early-pick + offer one-month SLA credit if we still miss full commit.
maria: CloudWave is also recalculating lead-times across other partners; recommends we send a revised reservation forecast to avoid future splits.
leo: actions: (1) oliver confirm if 6 racks can be staged by 9/17 with expedited labor, (2) maria confirm CloudWave early-pick cost, (3) rahul prepare draft comms.
oliver: estimate: expedited ops cost ~$18k, staging ETA 2026-09-17 EOD if approved. WO will be created.
maria: CloudWave reply: "we can early-pick CW-PO-4473 for 30% of its freight and shift CW-PO-4472 tranche1 forward 2 days if confirmed asap."
sophia: i'm OK with the early pick if finance/legal OK with one-off freight PO.
leo: tagging finance for approval up to $25k for expedited freight/labor.
rahul: drafting comms: "Quick update: due to partner shipment split, onboarding will be staged: initial activation week of 9/20, final capacity by 9/29. We offer a pro-rated credit and priority support during staging."
orion-bot: calendar: tentative staging surge hold 2026-09-18 created.
maria: decision: approve expedited staging + accept CloudWave early-pick for CW-PO-4473. oliver open WO and invoice to finance; rahul to send comms after staging ETA confirmed.
oliver: WO-7832 created with expedited labor lines; staging ETA 2026-09-17 EOD. Manifest will follow.
leo: updating capacity dashboard and adding on-call for 9/18.
rahul: comms posted in thread; will send to customers once ops confirms manifest.
sophia: prepping account teams for outreach.
maria: follow-up: partnerships should negotiate a 14-day firm-notice requirement on PO splits for critical commits. I'll add to backlog.
leo: we've had multiple splits this quarter; need stronger marketplace SLOs or penalty terms.
maria: noted and filing in partnerships backlog. Thanks team :thumbsup:
